mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Good digital tools should not be a privilege of large corporations with in-house IT departments. We help small and mid-sized businesses get the same quality of websites and internal tools — without inflated budgets, and without needing a technical background to take part in the process.

story.title: How we started
story.text: The studio grew out of a simple observation: most business owners have been burnt by a contractor at least once. Vague estimates, shifting deadlines, hand-overs nobody could maintain. We built Vižon around the opposite of that experience — fixed scope, clear pricing, and documentation that lets you leave us if you ever want to.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The questions we hear most often, answered plainly.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A compact website usually takes 3 to 5 weeks. A corporate site with several sections takes 6 to 10 weeks. B2B tools depend on the complexity of the processes involved — we give you a firm timeline after the first discovery call.

The price depends on the number of pages or screens, the complexity of the features, and how much content needs to be produced. After a short discovery call we give you a fixed estimate that does not move unless you change the scope yourself.

items.q: Do I need to prepare texts and photos myself?
items.a: Not necessarily. If you have materials, we will work with them. If you do not, we can write the texts and arrange photography — this is priced separately and agreed up front.

items.q: Will I be able to update the site myself?
items.a: Yes. Every site we deliver comes with an admin panel for editing text, images, and pages. We run a hand-over session and leave you written instructions.
The first month of support is included: we fix anything that behaves unexpectedly and help you settle in. After that you can continue on a monthly support plan or simply contact us as needed.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Latvia?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely with clients across Europe. Calls, documents, and hand-over all happen online — in English, Latvian, or Russian.

items.q: What if I already have a site and just want it improved?
items.a: That is exactly what the redesign service is for. We start with an audit of what you have, identify what is holding results back, and propose the smallest change that will move the needle.

cta.title: Not sure which service you need?
cta.text: Describe your task in a few sentences. We will tell you which approach fits — or whether you need one at all.

hero.title: Clear price ranges, no hidden extras
hero.subtitle: Below are realistic budgets for typical projects. After a short call we replace the range with a fixed number — and that number does not change unless you change the scope.

intro.title: How we price work
intro.text: We do not charge by the hour, because that makes your final bill impossible to predict. Instead we agree the scope up front and quote a fixed price for it. If something needs to change mid-project, we tell you what it costs before doing it.

factors.title: What affects the final price
factors.subtitle: Three things move a project up or down the range.

items.title: Scope and complexity
items.text: The number of pages or screens, and whether you need things like payments, integrations with your accounting system, or multi-role access.

items.title: Content and materials
items.text: Whether you supply texts and images, or we produce them. Copywriting, photography, and translation are priced separately.

items.title: Timeline
items.text: A standard schedule costs what is quoted. If you need the project compressed into a shorter window, that carries a surcharge.

custom.title: Your project doesn't fit the ranges?
custom.text: Most interesting projects don't. Describe what you need and we will prepare an individual estimate — free, and with no obligation to proceed.

pricing.note: All prices are shown excluding VAT and serve as a guide. The final cost is fixed in the contract after the discovery call.
